scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/report.mjs
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint:ci && npm --prefix frontend run lint:ci
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.audit: npm --prefix backend audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=high
scripts.ci: npm run check:architecture && npm run check:scripts && npm run check:prisma && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run audit && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.ci:clean: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix backend run db:generate && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm run ci
